terms.definition: An atom or group of atoms with an electric charge, formed by losing or gaining electrons.
terms.examiner: Metals lose electrons to form positive ions.

terms.definition: The strong electrostatic attraction between oppositely charged ions in a giant lattice.
terms.examiner: Forms between a metal and a non-metal.

terms.definition: A shared pair of electrons between two atoms.
The attraction between positive metal ions and a sea of delocalised electrons.
A diagram showing the electrons in the outer shells of the atoms or ions, with each atom's electrons drawn as dots or crosses.
terms.examiner: Show the charge on each ion in brackets.

terms.definition: A regular structure of oppositely charged ions held by strong forces acting in all directions.
terms.examiner: Sodium chloride is the standard example.
